q2_gaps: The content / material "with"-phrase of a locative-alternation verb ("fill one vessel WITH mire-essence"): the instruction set splits a with-phrase only two ways — an animate co-participant (CoAgent) or the means the action is performed by (Instrument) — and the essence is neither; it is the substance that ends up in the filled object. No role names that argument, so the parse routes it to Instrument by elimination.
notes: Second, smaller gap: the numeral in "one vessel" has no carrier — Cardinality rides on a group witness, and a singular count NP has none, so the count survives only implicitly as the per-day Skolem witness. Otherwise faithful: adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject correctly routed to a 0.9/0.9 distributing rule with no QuantifierPhrase (no quantifier word), Patient for the filled vessel, and the bare kind filler plus its genus atom for the generic mire-essence.
